summary: Tested Custom Builder fixes (DraggableCore error) and new admin review reply feature end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 pytest passed across admin reviews listing, review submission with images, stats breakdown, admin reply POST/DELETE, moderate feature/unfeature, 401/404/400 edge cases. Frontend: Custom builder loads cleanly with ZERO DraggableCore/page/console errors. Verified ADD TEXT, DRAG (smooth, no errors), SMALLER/LARGER/ROTATE/DELETE buttons, FRONT/BACK side switching (elements persist per side), dynamic price update (Base ₹499 + Back Print ₹150 = ₹649). All 8 t-shirt colors render. ZURO REPLY badge correctly displayed on Product Detail page when admin reply exists. Image upload UI present (not stressed with large files).

minor.issue: Reply text trimmed but no max-length validation; very long replies are accepted. Consider 2000-char cap.
images array accepts any string (URLs); no validation that they are uploaded ZURO storage URLs or size/type limits. Open to abuse with arbitrary external links.
Returns up to 500 reviews unpaginated; missing limit/offset query params.

issues: No data-testid attributes on ADD TEXT, UPLOAD IMAGE, SMALLER/LARGER/ROTATE/DELETE buttons, color swatches, FRONT/BACK toggles — relied on text selectors for testing. Recommend adding data-testid for stable automation.

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid attributes to Custom Builder controls and admin reply textarea/button for resilient E2E testing.
(Optional) Validate review image URLs (whitelist storage host or accept only paths returned by /api/upload).
(Optional) Cap admin reply length (e.g., 2000 chars) and add pagination to /api/admin/reviews.
critical_code_review_comments: DraggableElement.js correctly uses nodeRef pattern for react-draggable v4.x — issue fully resolved.
ErrorBoundary is wrapped only around the builder; consider top-level boundary in App.js for global resilience.
moderate_review endpoint accepts arbitrary 'action' query param — properly validated against enum; good.
reply_to_review trims whitespace and rejects empty replies — good UX.
Reviews endpoint stores raw images list with no size/host validation — see minor backend issue.
seed_data_creation: Tests register transient users (replytarget_*, reviewer_*) and create reviews with TEST_ comment prefix. Admin reply is added then deleted by test_admin_reply_delete to keep DB clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Custom Builder is stable on react-draggable v4.4.6 with nodeRef. Admin reply endpoints (POST/DELETE /api/admin/reviews/{id}/reply) and moderation (feature/unfeature/approve/reject) all verified. ZURO REPLY badge renders correctly on /product/{id}. If retesting, large-image upload to /api/upload was not stress-tested — could exercise file size limits next time.
rca_of_the_issue: Original 'DraggableCore not mounted on DragStart!' was caused by react-draggable v4+ requiring an explicit nodeRef when used with React 18 StrictMode (findDOMNode deprecated). Fixed by extracting a memoized DraggableElement component that creates a useRef and passes it to both <Draggable nodeRef={...}> and the child <div ref={...}>. No DraggableCore errors observed in current test run; drag/drop, resize, rotate, delete, front/back side switching, color switching, and price updates all confirmed functional.
